verdict.rationale: Availability visibility is a fair question for a GPU cloud, but the evidence pack never documents a real-time view of GPU capacity by type and region, whether in the console or through an API endpoint. The docs only list the GPU types offered (docs-21), describe the Cloud API generically as a way to create and manage resources, and say access is "first-come" (docs-28). An unofficial community CLI mentions agents being able to "find" instances, but that is third-party and does not establish an official availability view by region.
